item.title: Bloomberg Study Finds AI-Exposed Jobs in China Fell 10 Points Faster
item.description:
A Bloomberg analysis of nearly 10 million online job postings from July 2021 to June 2025 found that listings for roles highly exposed to AI declined about 10 percentage points more than less-exposed roles, with entry-level and creative positions hit hardest. Total online postings halved in the three years after ChatGPT's launch, though analysts caution against attributing the shift to AI alone, citing business-cycle and remote-work effects.

原文标题：彭博分析千万岗位 AI 暴露职位降幅高 10 个百分点

Why it matters：基于千万级岗位数据的实证分析，为 AI 对就业结构的冲击提供了可量化的宏观证据。

item.title: Anthropic Mathematician Claims Riemann Hypothesis Proof Co-Authored with Claude
item.description:
Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpoge claims to have proven the Riemann Hypothesis in collaboration with Claude, extending the result to the broader Generalized Riemann Hypothesis and encoding the proof in Lean for formal verification. If confirmed, it would mark the first AI-assisted proof of a top-tier open mathematical problem and a pivotal leap in AI mathematical reasoning.

原文标题：Anthropic 数学家称与 Claude 合作证明黎曼猜想

Why it matters：黎曼猜想级别的数学突破若被 Lean 验证，将是 AI 推理能力的里程碑事件，值得所有关注前沿模型能力边界的读者优先关注。

item.title: Navier-Stokes Blow-Up Paper Formally Verified in Lean 4
item.description:
Mathematicians L. Alpöge and T. Buckmaster released a Lean 4 repository accompanying their paper on finite-time blow-up for the Navier-Stokes equations, featuring a roughly 2,270-file, 600,000-line proof library with comparator configs restricting proofs to three standard axioms. The repository contains no data, the certificate hash cited in the paper is not yet included, and rigorous verification of Appendix B conditions relies on 128-bit interval arithmetic.

原文标题：Navier-Stokes 有限时间爆破论文完成 Lean 4 形式化

Why it matters：这是 AI 辅助数学形式化在千禧年难题级问题上的重要工程实践，对形式化验证与 AI for Math 读者具有直接参考价值。

item.title: US Grid Equipment Shortage May Hit 2027 as AI Data Centers Drive Two-Thirds of Gap
item.description:
A Johns Hopkins study in Cell Reports Sustainability finds US electricity demand will grow 21% by 2030, driven by AI data centers, EVs and electrification, triggering shortages of copper, steel and nickel as early as 2027. Transformer supply gaps approach 15% over the next four years and other key grid equipment gaps reach 30%, with data centers accounting for roughly two-thirds of the projected shortfall, constraining new plant and data center interconnection while pushing up power bills.

原文标题：美国最早 2027 年面临电网设备短缺，AI 数据中心占缺口三分之二

Why it matters：首次以材料供应链量化 AI 算力扩张的电网瓶颈，直接关系数据中心并网节奏与算力成本。

item.title: NVIDIA Releases Sigma Diffusion Language Models with 3.46x Faster Decoding
item.description:
NVIDIA released Nemotron-Labs-Sigma, 14 continuous diffusion language model checkpoints at 3B and 8B that move diffusion out of discrete token space into a learned 16-D embedding space, adding and removing Gaussian noise block by block. Sigma-8B averages 71.16 on NVIDIA's 6-task base suite versus 70.22 for the discrete-diffusion NLD-8B, and self-speculative decoding runs 3.46x faster on average (up to 4.20x) on a single GB200. The trade-off is clear: instruct average of 59.14 trails NLD-8B's 59.92, and AIME25 sits at just 17.00.

原文标题：英伟达发布 Sigma 扩散语言模型 解码提速 3.46 倍

Why it matters：英伟达把扩散语言模型推向连续嵌入空间并给出可复现的加速数据，是扩散式 LLM 路线的重要工程节点。

item.title: Samsung Device Unit Sees Memory Costs Surge 263 Percent
item.description:

Memory purchases reached 7.7 trillion won, or 12.3% of raw material spending, pushing the MX and NW businesses into a second consecutive quarterly loss and illustrating how AI-driven memory inflation is squeezing device makers' margins.
